rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: The year ending March 2026 release was published on 22 July 2026 and applies to England.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: The release is classified as Accredited Official Statistics.

rows.source: Fire and rescue statistics collection
rows.verified: The incident-statistics series is updated quarterly.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Incident collection moved from the Incident Recording System to the Fire and Rescue Data Platform in November 2025.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Fire and rescue services attended 641,227 incidents, 5.8% more than the previous year.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Services attended 170,597 fires, an annual increase of 19%.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: There were 254 fire-related fatalities in 239 fatal fires, compared with 280 fatalities in 255 fatal fires previously.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Fires represented 27% of incidents, false alarms 40%, and non-fire incidents 34%.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: There were 66,383 primary fires, 7.3% more than the previous year.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: There were 26,180 dwelling fires, an annual increase of 2.8%.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: There were 23,795 accidental dwelling fires, an annual increase of 3.5%.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: There were 13,679 other-building fires, an annual increase of 3.7%.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: There were 19,600 road-vehicle fires, an annual increase of 5.7%.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Outdoor primary fires increased by 48% to 6,924.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Secondary fires increased by 30% to 102,549.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Fire false alarms increased by 1.6% to 255,047.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Non-fire incidents increased by 1.7% to 215,583.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Services attended 17,502 flooding or water-rescue incidents, including 15,920 flooding incidents and 1,582 water rescues or evacuations.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: Average response time was 9 minutes 25 seconds for primary fires and 9 minutes 58 seconds for secondary fires.

rows.source: MHCLG fire and rescue incident statistics
rows.verified: The release uses a 12 May 2026 snapshot, may be revised, and notes an undercount for Suffolk during a technical submission problem.
